editorial.blurb: A hidden neighborhood gem serving exquisite sushi and flavorful Thai curries at remarkably honest prices, where every order arrives with care.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Sushi Deluxe ($30 for 8 pieces of nigiri, miso soup, and rainbow roll) for the best value, and take advantage of their super late ordering times available via delivery apps.
